features.name: any_comment_quotes_op_text
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment directly quote wording from the original poster's title or argument?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users). Return 1 if at least one comment contains an explicit, direct textual quotation (verbatim or near-verbatim reuse, e.g. a markdown '>' blockquote or quotation-marked words) of wording that actually appears in the OP's title or argument; compare against title and argument to verify the quoted text comes from the OP. Quotation marks alone do not suffice: the quoted text must match OP text, not another source or a paraphrase. Quotations of other commenters or external sources do not count. Ignore any quoted OP text that is merely an OP view-change/delta-award announcement or post-outcome resolution/edit reporting the outcome; such text is not evidence. Return 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment quotes OP text. Return null if OC_comments, title or argument is missing or malformed.

h0: any_comment_quotes_op_text has no association with view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with any_comment_quotes_op_text = 1 have higher view change than those with 0.
note: Operational assumption: "counter-arguments contain direct quotations from the OP" is measured as at least one comment quoting OP title/argument text; the comparison group is discussions with no such quotation. Argument text is current text and may include edits or outcome announcements; the feature ignores those announcements as evidence, but comment timing is unknown. Comments are unordered, with no reply links inferred. Association only, not causal.
